1→// This is your Prisma schema file,
     2→// learn more about it in the docs: https://pris.ly/d/prisma-schema
     3→
     4→generator client {
     5→  provider = "prisma-client-js"
     6→}
     7→
     8→datasource db {
     9→  provider  = "postgresql"
    10→  url       = env("DATABASE_URL")
    11→  directUrl = env("DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED") // Direct connection for migrations (bypasses pooler)
    12→}
    13→
    14→/// Package table - stores NPM package metadata (package-level)
    15→model Package {
    16→  id String @id @default(cuid())
    17→
    18→  // NPM Metadata
    19→  npmPackageName String   @unique @map("npm_package_name") @db.VarChar(214)
    20→  npmVersion     String   @map("npm_version") @db.VarChar(50)
    21→  npmPublishedAt DateTime @map("npm_published_at")
    22→  npmDescription String?  @map("npm_description") @db.Text
    23→  npmRepository  Json?    @map("npm_repository") @db.JsonB
    24→  npmHomepage    String?  @map("npm_homepage") @db.Text
    25→  npmLicense     String?  @map("npm_license") @db.VarChar(50)
    26→  npmKeywords    String[] @default([]) @map("npm_keywords") @db.Text
    27→  npmReadme      String?  @map("npm_readme") @db.Text
    28→  npmAuthor      Json?    @map("npm_author") @db.JsonB
    29→  npmMaintainers Json?    @map("npm_maintainers") @db.JsonB
    30→
    31→  // TPMJS Package-Level Metadata
    32→  category       String   @db.VarChar(50)
    33→  env            Json?    @db.JsonB // Environment variables (shared across tools)
    34→  frameworks     String[] @default([]) @db.Text
    35→  tier           String   @db.VarChar(20) // 'minimal' | 'rich'
    36→  discoveryMethod String  @map("discovery_method") @db.VarChar(20) // 'keyword' | 'changes-feed'
    37→  isOfficial     Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_official")
    38→
    39→  // Package Metrics
    40→  npmDownloadsLastMonth Int? @default(0) @map("npm_downloads_last_month")
    41→  githubStars           Int? @default(0) @map("github_stars")
    42→
    43→  // Timestamps
    44→  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
    45→  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
    46→
    47→  // Relations
    48→  tools Tool[]
    49→
    50→  @@index([category])
    51→  @@index([isOfficial])
    52→  @@index([npmDownloadsLastMonth])
    53→  @@index([createdAt])
    54→  @@map("packages")
    55→}
    56→
    57→/// Tool table - stores individual tools within packages
    58→model Tool {
    59→  id String @id @default(cuid())
    60→
    61→  // Package Relation
    62→  packageId String  @map("package_id")
    63→  package   Package @relation(fields: [packageId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
    64→
    65→  // Tool Identity
    66→  name String @db.VarChar(100) // e.g., "helloWorldTool", "default"
    67→
    68→  // Tool Metadata
    69→  description String @db.Text
    70→  parameters  Json?  @db.JsonB // Legacy/fallback - author-provided parameters array
    71→  returns     Json?  @db.JsonB // @deprecated - will be auto-extracted in future
    72→  aiAgent     Json?  @map("ai_agent") @db.JsonB // @deprecated - will be auto-extracted in future
    73→
    74→  // Schema Extraction Fields
    75→  inputSchema                Json?     @map("input_schema") @db.JsonB // Full JSON Schema from executor
    76→  schemaSource               String?   @map("schema_source") @db.VarChar(20) // 'extracted' | 'author' | null
    77→  schemaExtractedAt          DateTime? @map("schema_extracted_at") // Only updated on successful extraction
    78→  schemaExtractionAttemptAt  DateTime? @map("schema_extraction_attempt_at") // Updated on every attempt (for rate limiting)
    79→  schemaExtractionError      String?   @map("schema_extraction_error") @db.Text // Error message from last failed attempt
    80→
    81→  // Tool Discovery Fields
    82→  toolDiscoverySource String? @map("tool_discovery_source") @db.VarChar(20) // 'auto' | 'manual' | null
    83→
    84→  // Tool Metrics
    85→  qualityScore Decimal? @map("quality_score") @db.Decimal(3, 2) // 0.00 to 1.00
    86→  likeCount    Int      @default(0) @map("like_count")
    87→
    88→  // Health Status Fields
    89→  importHealth     HealthStatus? @default(UNKNOWN) @map("import_health")
    90→  executionHealth  HealthStatus? @default(UNKNOWN) @map("execution_health")
    91→  lastHealthCheck  DateTime?     @map("last_health_check")
    92→  healthCheckError String?       @map("health_check_error") @db.Text
    93→
    94→  // Timestamps
    95→  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
    96→  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
    97→
    98→  // View tracking (denormalized, rolled up daily)
    99→  viewCount      Int      @default(0) @map("view_count")
   100→
   101→  // Execution tracking (denormalized, rolled up daily)
   102→  executionCount Int      @default(0) @map("execution_count")
   103→
   104→  // Rating aggregates
   105→  averageRating Decimal? @map("average_rating") @db.Decimal(2, 1) // 1.0 to 5.0
   106→  ratingCount   Int      @default(0) @map("rating_count")
   107→  reviewCount   Int      @default(0) @map("review_count")
   108→
   109→  // Relations
   110→  simulations     Simulation[]
   111→  healthChecks    HealthCheck[]
   112→  collections     CollectionTool[]
   113→  agents          AgentTool[]
   114→  likes           ToolLike[]
   115→  ratings         ToolRating[]
   116→  reviews         ToolReview[]
   117→  skillsCache     ToolSkillsCache?
   118→  skillQuestions  SkillQuestionTool[]
   119→
   120→  @@unique([packageId, name])
   121→  @@index([qualityScore])
   122→  @@index([likeCount])
   123→  @@index([averageRating])
   124→  @@index([ratingCount])
   125→  @@index([viewCount])
   126→  @@index([executionCount])
   127→  @@index([reviewCount])
   128→  @@index([importHealth])
   129→  @@index([executionHealth])
   130→  @@index([lastHealthCheck])
   131→  @@map("tools")
   132→}
   133→
   134→/// Sync checkpoints - tracks progress of sync workers
   135→model SyncCheckpoint {
   136→  id String @id @default(cuid())
   137→
   138→  source     String   @unique @db.VarChar(50) // 'changes-feed' | 'keyword-search' | 'metrics'
   139→  checkpoint Json     @db.JsonB // Stores last sequence, timestamp, etc.
   140→  updatedAt  DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
   141→
   142→  @@map("sync_checkpoints")
   143→}
   144→
   145→/// Sync logs - audit trail of sync operations
   146→model SyncLog {
   147→  id String @id @default(cuid())
   148→
   149→  source    String   @db.VarChar(50) // 'changes-feed' | 'keyword-search' | 'metrics'
   150→  status    String   @db.VarChar(20) // 'success' | 'error' | 'partial'
   151→  processed Int      @default(0) // Number of packages processed
   152→  skipped   Int      @default(0) // Number of packages skipped
   153→  errors    Int      @default(0) // Number of errors encountered
   154→  message   String?  @db.Text // Error message or summary
   155→  metadata  Json?    @db.JsonB // Additional context
   156→  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
   157→
   158→  @@index([source])
   159→  @@index([status])
   160→  @@index([createdAt])
   161→  @@map("sync_logs")
   162→}
   163→
   164→/// Simulations - tracks tool playground executions
   165→model Simulation {
   166→  id String @id @default(cuid())
   167→
   168→  // Relations
   169→  toolId String @map("tool_id")
   170→  tool   Tool   @relation(fields: [toolId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
   171→
   172→  // Request data
   173→  userPrompt String  @map("user_prompt") @db.Text
   174→  parameters Json?   @db.JsonB
   175→  ipAddress  String? @map("ip_address") @db.VarChar(45)
   176→  userAgent  String? @map("user_agent") @db.Text
   177→
   178→  // Results
   179→  status          String  @db.VarChar(20) // pending|running|success|error|timeout
   180→  executionTimeMs Int?    @map("execution_time_ms")
   181→  output          Json?   @db.JsonB
   182→  error           String? @db.Text
   183→
   184→  // AI metadata
   185→  agentSteps Int     @default(0) @map("agent_steps")
   186→  model      String? @db.VarChar(50)
   187→
   188→  // Relations
   189→  tokenUsage   TokenUsage?
   190→  logs         ExecutionLog[]
   191→
   192→  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
   193→  completedAt DateTime? @map("completed_at")
   194→
   195→  @@index([toolId])

Explore the TPMJS codebase to understand the MCP (Model Context Protocol) architecture. I need to understand:

1. How MCP servers are currently handled - search for "mcp" across the codebase
2. How tools are structured in the database and in the tools package (packages/tools/)
3. Look at the blocks.yml files and how tools are defined
4. Look at how tools are served/executed - any MCP server implementation
5. Look at the tool model in Prisma schema (packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma) - understand all tool-related fields
6. Any SSE (Server-Sent Events) implementation that exists
7. How tool execution works end-to-end

Search for patterns like "sse", "mcp", "StreamableHTTP", "tool", "blocks" across the codebase. Be very thorough.

Explore the TPMJS codebase to understand the collections system thoroughly. I need to understand:

1. The database schema for collections - find the Prisma schema and look at Collection, CollectionTool, and any related models
2. The API routes for collections - look in apps/web for any /api/collections routes or similar
3. The frontend pages/components for collections - look for collection creation, editing, viewing pages
4. How tools are currently added to collections (the relationship between tools and collections)
5. Any existing MCP-related code in the codebase

Be very thorough - search for "collection" across the codebase, look at the Prisma schema, explore the API routes and UI components. I need filenames, schemas, and key code patterns.

1. The different types of tools that exist (look at any enums or type fields in the Prisma schema)
2. How tools get into the registry - the sync process, the npm keyword system
3. The tool detail pages and how tools are displayed
4. How collections are displayed on the frontend - what does a collection page look like?

6. Any existing "custom" or "external" tool concepts
7. The MCP configuration/endpoint that serves tools from a collection

Search in apps/web/app/ for collection-related routes, look at the Prisma schema for tool types, and explore how the MCP endpoint works. Look for files related to mcp-config, claude.json generation, or similar.

1→// This is your Prisma schema file,
     2→// learn more about it in the docs: https://pris.ly/d/prisma-schema
     3→
     4→generator client {
     5→  provider = "prisma-client-js"
     6→}
     7→
     8→datasource db {
     9→  provider  = "postgresql"
    10→  url       = env("DATABASE_URL")
    11→  directUrl = env("DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED") // Direct connection for migrations (bypasses pooler)
    12→}
    13→
    14→/// Package table - stores NPM package metadata (package-level)
    15→model Package {
    16→  id String @id @default(cuid())
    17→
    18→  // NPM Metadata
    19→  npmPackageName String   @unique @map("npm_package_name") @db.VarChar(214)
    20→  npmVersion     String   @map("npm_version") @db.VarChar(50)
    21→  npmPublishedAt DateTime @map("npm_published_at")
    22→  npmDescription String?  @map("npm_description") @db.Text
    23→  npmRepository  Json?    @map("npm_repository") @db.JsonB
    24→  npmHomepage    String?  @map("npm_homepage") @db.Text
    25→  npmLicense     String?  @map("npm_license") @db.VarChar(50)
    26→  npmKeywords    String[] @default([]) @map("npm_keywords") @db.Text
    27→  npmReadme      String?  @map("npm_readme") @db.Text
    28→  npmAuthor      Json?    @map("npm_author") @db.JsonB
    29→  npmMaintainers Json?    @map("npm_maintainers") @db.JsonB
    30→
    31→  // TPMJS Package-Level Metadata
    32→  category       String   @db.VarChar(50)
    33→  env            Json?    @db.JsonB // Environment variables (shared across tools)
    34→  frameworks     String[] @default([]) @db.Text
    35→  tier           String   @db.VarChar(20) // 'minimal' | 'rich'
    36→  discoveryMethod String  @map("discovery_method") @db.VarChar(20) // 'keyword' | 'changes-feed'
    37→  isOfficial     Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_official")
    38→
    39→  // Package Metrics
    40→  npmDownloadsLastMonth Int? @default(0) @map("npm_downloads_last_month")
    41→  githubStars           Int? @default(0) @map("github_stars")
    42→
    43→  // Timestamps
    44→  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
    45→  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
    46→
    47→  // Relations
    48→  tools Tool[]
    49→
    50→  @@index([category])
    51→  @@index([isOfficial])
    52→  @@index([npmDownloadsLastMonth])
    53→  @@index([createdAt])
    54→  @@map("packages")
    55→}
    56→
    57→/// Tool table - stores individual tools within packages
    58→model Tool {
    59→  id String @id @default(cuid())
    60→
    61→  // Package Relation
    62→  packageId String  @map("package_id")
    63→  package   Package @relation(fields: [packageId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
    64→
    65→  // Tool Identity
    66→  name String @db.VarChar(100) // e.g., "helloWorldTool", "default"
    67→
    68→  // Tool Metadata
    69→  description String @db.Text
    70→  parameters  Json?  @db.JsonB // Legacy/fallback - author-provided parameters array
    71→  returns     Json?  @db.JsonB // @deprecated - will be auto-extracted in future
    72→  aiAgent     Json?  @map("ai_agent") @db.JsonB // @deprecated - will be auto-extracted in future
    73→
    74→  // Schema Extraction Fields
    75→  inputSchema                Json?     @map("input_schema") @db.JsonB // Full JSON Schema from executor
    76→  schemaSource               String?   @map("schema_source") @db.VarChar(20) // 'extracted' | 'author' | null
    77→  schemaExtractedAt          DateTime? @map("schema_extracted_at") // Only updated on successful extraction
    78→  schemaExtractionAttemptAt  DateTime? @map("schema_extraction_attempt_at") // Updated on every attempt (for rate limiting)
    79→  schemaExtractionError      String?   @map("schema_extraction_error") @db.Text // Error message from last failed attempt
    80→
    81→  // Tool Discovery Fields
    82→  toolDiscoverySource String? @map("tool_discovery_source") @db.VarChar(20) // 'auto' | 'manual' | null
    83→
    84→  // Tool Metrics
    85→  qualityScore Decimal? @map("quality_score") @db.Decimal(3, 2) // 0.00 to 1.00
    86→  likeCount    Int      @default(0) @map("like_count")
    87→
    88→  // Health Status Fields
    89→  importHealth     HealthStatus? @default(UNKNOWN) @map("import_health")
    90→  executionHealth  HealthStatus? @default(UNKNOWN) @map("execution_health")
    91→  lastHealthCheck  DateTime?     @map("last_health_check")
    92→  healthCheckError String?       @map("health_check_error") @db.Text
    93→
    94→  // Timestamps
    95→  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
    96→  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
    97→
    98→  // View tracking (denormalized, rolled up daily)
    99→  viewCount      Int      @default(0) @map("view_count")
   100→
   101→  // Execution tracking (denormalized, rolled up daily)
   102→  executionCount Int      @default(0) @map("execution_count")
   103→
   104→  // Rating aggregates
   105→  averageRating Decimal? @map("average_rating") @db.Decimal(2, 1) // 1.0 to 5.0
   106→  ratingCount   Int      @default(0) @map("rating_count")
   107→  reviewCount   Int      @default(0) @map("review_count")
   108→
   109→  // Relations
   110→  simulations     Simulation[]
   111→  healthChecks    HealthCheck[]
   112→  collections     CollectionTool[]
   113→  agents          AgentTool[]
   114→  likes           ToolLike[]
   115→  ratings         ToolRating[]
   116→  reviews         ToolReview[]
   117→  skillsCache     ToolSkillsCache?
   118→  skillQuestions  SkillQuestionTool[]
   119→
   120→  @@unique([packageId, name])
   121→  @@index([qualityScore])
   122→  @@index([likeCount])
   123→  @@index([averageRating])
   124→  @@index([ratingCount])
   125→  @@index([viewCount])
   126→  @@index([executionCount])
   127→  @@index([reviewCount])
   128→  @@index([importHealth])
   129→  @@index([executionHealth])
   130→  @@index([lastHealthCheck])
   131→  @@map("tools")
   132→}
   133→
   134→/// Sync checkpoints - tracks progress of sync workers
   135→model SyncCheckpoint {
   136→  id String @id @default(cuid())
   137→
   138→  source     String   @unique @db.VarChar(50) // 'changes-feed' | 'keyword-search' | 'metrics'
   139→  checkpoint Json     @db.JsonB // Stores last sequence, timestamp, etc.
   140→  updatedAt  DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
   141→
   142→  @@map("sync_checkpoints")
   143→}
   144→
   145→/// Sync logs - audit trail of sync operations
   146→model SyncLog {
   147→  id String @id @default(cuid())
   148→
   149→  source    String   @db.VarChar(50) // 'changes-feed' | 'keyword-search' | 'metrics'
   150→  status    String   @db.VarChar(20) // 'success' | 'error' | 'partial'
   151→  processed Int      @default(0) // Number of packages processed
   152→  skipped   Int      @default(0) // Number of packages skipped
   153→  errors    Int      @default(0) // Number of errors encountered
   154→  message   String?  @db.Text // Error message or summary
   155→  metadata  Json?    @db.JsonB // Additional context
   156→  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
   157→
   158→  @@index([source])
   159→  @@index([status])
   160→  @@index([createdAt])
   161→  @@map("sync_logs")
   162→}
   163→
   164→/// Simulations - tracks tool playground executions
   165→model Simulation {
   166→  id String @id @default(cuid())
   167→
   168→  // Relations
   169→  toolId String @map("tool_id")
   170→  tool   Tool   @relation(fields: [toolId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
   171→
   172→  // Request data
   173→  userPrompt String  @map("user_prompt") @db.Text
   174→  parameters Json?   @db.JsonB
   175→  ipAddress  String? @map("ip_address") @db.VarChar(45)
   176→  userAgent  String? @map("user_agent") @db.Text
   177→
   178→  // Results
   179→  status          String  @db.VarChar(20) // pending|running|success|error|timeout
   180→  executionTimeMs Int?    @map("execution_time_ms")
   181→  output          Json?   @db.JsonB
   182→  error           String? @db.Text
   183→
   184→  // AI metadata
   185→  agentSteps Int     @default(0) @map("agent_steps")
   186→  model      String? @db.VarChar(50)
   187→
   188→  // Relations
   189→  tokenUsage   TokenUsage?
   190→  logs         ExecutionLog[]
   191→
   192→  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
   193→  completedAt DateTime? @map("completed_at")
   194→
   195→  @@index([toolId])
   196→  @@index([status])
   197→  @@index([ipAddress, createdAt]) // For rate limiting
   198→  @@map("simulations")
   199→}
   200→
   201→/// Token usage - tracks token consumption per simulation
   202→model TokenUsage {
   203→  id String @id @default(cuid())
   204→
   205→  simulationId String     @unique @map("simulation_id")
   206→  simulation   Simulation @relation(fields: [simulationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
   207→
   208→  inputTokens    Int      @default(0) @map("input_tokens")
   209→  toolDescTokens Int      @default(0) @map("tool_desc_tokens")
   210→  schemaTokens   Int      @default(0) @map("schema_tokens")
   211→  outputTokens   Int      @default(0) @map("output_tokens")
   212→  totalTokens    Int      @default(0) @map("total_tokens")
   213→  estimatedCost  Decimal? @map("estimated_cost") @db.Decimal(10, 6)
   214→
   215→  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
   216→  @@map("token_usage")
   217→}
   218→
   219→/// Execution logs - detailed logs for each simulation
   220→model ExecutionLog {
   221→  id String @id @default(cuid())
   222→
   223→  simulationId String     @map("simulation_id")
   224→  simulation   Simulation @relation(fields: [simulationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
   225→
   226→  timestamp DateTime @default(now())
   227→  level     String   @db.VarChar(20) // info|warning|error|debug
   228→  event     String   @db.VarChar(50)
   229→  message   String   @db.Text
   230→  metadata  Json?    @db.JsonB
   231→
   232→  @@index([simulationId])
   233→  @@map("execution_logs")
   234→}
   235→
   236→/// HealthCheck table - tracks full audit history of health checks
   237→model HealthCheck {
   238→  id String @id @default(cuid())
   239→
   240→  // Relations
   241→  toolId String @map("tool_id")
   242→  tool   Tool   @relation(fields: [toolId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
   243→
   244→  // Check metadata
   245→  checkType     HealthCheckType @map("check_type")
   246→  triggerSource String          @map("trigger_source") @db.VarChar(50) // 'sync' | 'manual' | 'daily-cron'
   247→
   248→  // Import check results
   249→  importStatus HealthStatus @map("import_status")
   250→  importError  String?      @map("import_error") @db.Text
   251→  importTimeMs Int?         @map("import_time_ms")
   252→
   253→  // Execution check results
   254→  executionStatus HealthStatus @map("execution_status")
   255→  executionError  String?      @map("execution_error") @db.Text
   256→  executionTimeMs Int?         @map("execution_time_ms")
   257→  testParameters  Json?        @map("test_parameters") @db.JsonB
   258→
   259→  // Overall status
   260→  overallStatus HealthStatus @map("overall_status")
   261→
   262→  // Timestamps
   263→  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
   264→
   265→  @@index([toolId])
   266→  @@index([checkType])
   267→  @@index([overallStatus])
   268→  @@index([createdAt])
   269→  @@map("health_checks")
   270→}
   271→
   272→/// Health status enum - tracks health check results

  1389→/// UseCase - auto-generated marketing content from qualifying scenarios
  1390→model UseCase {

  1393→  scenario          Scenario          @relation(fields: [scenarioId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  1394→
  1395→  // SEO-friendly slug

  1397→
  1398→  // AI-generated marketing content
  1399→  marketingTitle    String            @map("marketing_title") @db.VarChar(200)
  1400→  marketingDesc     String            @map("marketing_desc") @db.Text
  1401→  roiEstimate       String?           @map("roi_estimate") @db.Text  // "Saves ~10 hours/week"
  1402→  businessValue     String?           @map("business_value") @db.Text  // Human-readable benefit
  1403→  problemStatement  String?           @map("problem_statement") @db.Text  // What problem it solves
  1404→  solutionNarrative String?          @map("solution_narrative") @db.Text  // How it works

  1406→  // Ranking (computed nightly)

  1409→
  1410→  // Timestamps

  1415→  // Relations

  1418→  categories        UseCaseCategory[]
  1419→  socialProof       SocialProof?

  1421→  @@index([scenarioId])
  1422→  @@index([slug])
  1423→  @@index([rankScore])
  1424→  @@index([lastRankedAt])
  1425→  @@index([lastRegeneratedAt])
  1426→  @@map("use_cases")

  1428→
  1429→/// UseCasePersona - junction table for UseCase <-> Persona

  1442→
  1443→/// UseCaseIndustry - junction table for UseCase <-> Industry

  1446→  industryId String   @map("industry_id")
  1447→  useCase    UseCase  @relation(fields: [useCaseId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  1448→  industry   Industry @relation(fields: [industryId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  1449→
  1450→  @@id([useCaseId, industryId])
  1451→  @@index([useCaseId])
  1452→  @@index([industryId])
  1453→  @@map("use_case_industries")

  1455→
  1456→/// UseCaseCategory - junction table for UseCase <-> Category
  1457→model UseCaseCategory {
  1458→  useCaseId  String   @map("use_case_id")
  1459→  categoryId String   @map("category_id")
  1460→  useCase    UseCase  @relation(fields: [useCaseId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  1461→  category   Category @relation(fields: [categoryId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  1463→  @@id([useCaseId, categoryId])

  1465→  @@index([categoryId])
  1466→  @@map("use_case_categories")

  1468→
  1469→/// SocialProof - cached metrics from scenario runs for use cases
  1470→model SocialProof {
  1471→  id               String   @id @default(cuid())
  1472→  useCaseId        String   @unique @map("use_case_id")
  1473→  useCase          UseCase  @relation(fields: [useCaseId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  1474→
  1475→  qualityScore     Float    @map("quality_score")
  1476→  totalRuns        Int      @map("total_runs")
  1477→  consecutivePasses Int     @map("consecutive_passes")
  1478→  lastRunStatus    String?  @map("last_run_status") @db.VarChar(20)
  1479→  lastRunAt        DateTime? @map("last_run_at")
  1480→
  1481→  // Computed display fields
  1482→  successRate      Float?   @map("success_rate")
  1483→  lastRunAgo       String?  @map("last_run_ago") // "2 days ago"
  1484→
  1485→  updatedAt        DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  1486→
  1487→  @@index([useCaseId])
  1488→  @@index([qualityScore])
  1489→  @@index([totalRuns])
  1490→  @@map("social_proofs")

  1492→
  1493→// ============================================================================
  1494→// Skills Generation Models (Chunked Generation for Large Collections)
  1495→// ============================================================================
  1496→
  1497→/// ToolSkillsCache - per-tool cached skills markdown section
  1498→model ToolSkillsCache {
  1499→  id              String   @id @default(cuid())
  1500→
  1501→  // Tool relationship
  1502→  toolId          String   @unique @map("tool_id")
  1503→  tool            Tool     @relation(fields: [toolId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  1504→
  1505→  // Cached markdown section for this tool

  1507→
  1508→  // Timestamps

  1514→
  1515→/// SkillsGenerationJob - tracks chunked skills.md generation progress
  1516→model SkillsGenerationJob {
  1517→  id               String     @id @default(cuid())
  1518→
  1519→  // Collection relationship
  1520→  collectionId     String     @map("collection_id")
  1521→  collection       Collection @relation(fields: [collectionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  1522→
  1523→  // Job status

  1525→
  1526→  // Progress tracking

  1528→  totalBatches     Int        @map("total_batches")

  1531→  // Error tracking

  1542→
  1543→// ============================================================================
  1544→// Omega Models (AI Agent Chat with Full Registry Access)
  1545→// ============================================================================
  1546→
  1547→/// OmegaConversation - chat session for Omega AI agent
  1548→model OmegaConversation {
  1549→  id                String   @id @default(cuid())
  1550→
  1551→  // Owner relationship
  1552→  ownerId           String   @map("owner_id")
  1553→
  1554→  // Conversation metadata
  1555→  title             String?  @db.VarChar(200)
  1556→
  1557→  // Execution state
  1558→  executionState    String   @default("idle") @map("execution_state") @db.VarChar(20) // idle, running, paused, cancelled
  1559→
  1560→  // Token tracking (aggregate across all messages)
  1561→  inputTokensTotal  Int      @default(0) @map("input_tokens_total")
  1562→  outputTokensTotal Int      @default(0) @map("output_tokens_total")
  1563→
  1564→  // Timestamps
  1565→  createdAt         DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  1566→  updatedAt         DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  1567→
  1568→  // Relations
  1569→  messages          OmegaMessage[]
  1570→  participants      OmegaParticipant[]
  1571→  toolRuns          OmegaToolRun[]
  1572→
  1573→  @@index([ownerId])
  1574→  @@index([createdAt])
  1575→  @@map("omega_conversations")
  1576→}
  1577→
  1578→/// OmegaMessage - individual message in an Omega conversation
  1579→model OmegaMessage {
  1580→  id             String   @id @default(cuid())
  1581→
  1582→  // Conversation relationship
  1583→  conversationId String   @map("conversation_id")
  1584→  conversation   OmegaConversation @relation(fields: [conversationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  1585→
  1586→  // Message content
  1587→  role           MessageRole
  1588→  content        String   @db.Text
  1589→
  1590→  // Author info (for multi-user conversations)
  1591→  authorId       String?  @map("author_id")
  1592→  authorEmail    String?  @map("author_email")
  1593→  authorName     String?  @map("author_name") @db.VarChar(100)
  1594→
  1595→  // Tool calls (for ASSISTANT messages)
  1596→  toolCalls      Json?    @map("tool_calls") @db.JsonB
  1597→
  1598→  // Token tracking
  1599→  inputTokens    Int?     @map("input_tokens")
  1600→  outputTokens   Int?     @map("output_tokens")
  1601→
  1602→  // Timestamps
  1603→  createdAt      DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  1604→
  1605→  @@index([conversationId])
  1606→  @@index([createdAt])
  1607→  @@map("omega_messages")
  1608→}
  1609→
  1610→/// OmegaParticipant - tracks users in an Omega conversation
  1611→model OmegaParticipant {
  1612→  id             String   @id @default(cuid())
  1613→
  1614→  // Conversation relationship
  1615→  conversationId String   @map("conversation_id")
  1616→  conversation   OmegaConversation @relation(fields: [conversationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  1617→
  1618→  // User info
  1619→  userId         String?  @map("user_id")
  1620→  displayName    String   @map("display_name") @db.VarChar(100)
  1621→  email          String?
  1622→
  1623→  // Role in conversation
  1624→  role           String   @default("collaborator") @db.VarChar(20) // owner, collaborator
  1625→
  1626→  // Timestamps
  1627→  joinedAt       DateTime @default(now()) @map("joined_at")
  1628→
  1629→  @@unique([conversationId, userId])
  1630→  @@index([conversationId])
  1631→  @@map("omega_participants")
  1632→}
  1633→
  1634→/// OmegaToolRun - tracks tool executions within Omega conversations
  1635→model OmegaToolRun {
  1636→  id              String    @id @default(cuid())
  1637→
  1638→  // Conversation relationship
  1639→  conversationId  String    @map("conversation_id")
  1640→  conversation    OmegaConversation @relation(fields: [conversationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  1641→
  1642→  // Message relationship (optional - for linking to specific message)
  1643→  messageId       String?   @map("message_id")
  1644→
  1645→  // Tool execution details
  1646→  toolName        String    @map("tool_name") @db.VarChar(200)
  1647→  input           Json      @db.JsonB
  1648→  output          Json?     @db.JsonB
  1649→  error           String?   @db.Text
  1650→
  1651→  // Status tracking
  1652→  status          String    @db.VarChar(20) // pending, running, success, error
  1653→
  1654→  // Timing
  1655→  startedAt       DateTime  @default(now()) @map("started_at")
  1656→  completedAt     DateTime? @map("completed_at")
  1657→  executionTimeMs Int?      @map("execution_time_ms")
  1658→
  1659→  @@index([conversationId])
  1660→  @@index([status])
  1661→  @@map("omega_tool_runs")
  1662→}
  1663→
  1664→/// OmegaUserSettings - user preferences for Omega
  1665→model OmegaUserSettings {
  1666→  id                 String   @id @default(cuid())
  1667→
  1668→  // User relationship
  1669→  userId             String   @unique @map("user_id")
  1670→
  1671→  // Tool preferences
  1672→  pinnedToolIds      String[] @default([]) @map("pinned_tool_ids")
  1673→  blockedToolIds     String[] @default([]) @map("blocked_tool_ids")
  1674→
  1675→  // Customization
  1676→  customSystemPrompt String?  @map("custom_system_prompt") @db.Text
  1677→
  1678→  // UI preferences

  1680→
  1681→  // Timestamps

  1683→  updatedAt          DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  1684→
  1685→  @@map("omega_user_settings")
  1686→}
  1687→
  1688→// ============================================================================
  1689→// RealSkills Models (Living Skills Endpoint - Question-Driven Evolution)
  1690→// ============================================================================
  1691→
  1692→/// SkillQuestion - Agent questions stored with embeddings for RAG
  1693→model SkillQuestion {
  1694→  id           String     @id @default(cuid())
  1695→
  1696→  // Collection relationship
  1697→  collectionId String     @map("collection_id")
  1698→  collection   Collection @relation(fields: [collectionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  1699→
  1700→  // Question content
  1701→  question     String     @db.Text
  1702→  embedding    Json       @db.JsonB // Array of floats (3072 dims for text-embedding-3-large)
  1703→
  1704→  // Response
  1705→  answer       String     @db.Text
  1706→  answerTokens Int        @default(0) @map("answer_tokens")
  1707→
  1708→  // Agent identity (anonymized in UI)
  1709→  agentHash    String?    @map("agent_hash") @db.VarChar(64) // Hash of IP + user-agent for deduplication
  1710→  agentName    String?    @map("agent_name") @db.VarChar(100) // Self-reported agent name
  1711→  sessionId    String?    @map("session_id") // Optional session for multi-turn
  1712→
  1713→  // Metadata
  1714→  tags         String[]   @default([]) @db.Text
  1715→  confidence   Float      @default(0)
  1716→  similarCount Int        @default(0) @map("similar_count") // Times similar question asked
  1717→
  1718→  // Graph relationships
  1719→  skillNodes   SkillQuestionSkill[]
  1720→  toolNodes    SkillQuestionTool[]
  1721→
  1722→  // Timestamps
  1723→  createdAt    DateTime   @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  1724→  updatedAt    DateTime   @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  1725→
  1726→  @@index([collectionId])
  1727→  @@index([sessionId])
  1728→  @@index([createdAt])
  1729→  @@map("skill_questions")
  1730→}
  1731→
  1732→/// Skill - Emergent skill nodes identified from question patterns
  1733→model Skill {
  1734→  id           String     @id @default(cuid())
  1735→
  1736→  // Collection relationship
  1737→  collectionId String     @map("collection_id")
  1738→  collection   Collection @relation(fields: [collectionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  1739→
  1740→  // Skill identity
  1741→  name         String     @db.VarChar(200) // e.g., "React useEffect debugging"
  1742→  slug         String     @db.VarChar(200) // URL-safe version
  1743→  description  String     @db.Text
  1744→  embedding    Json       @db.JsonB // Array of floats (3072 dims for text-embedding-3-large)
  1745→
  1746→  // Stats
  1747→  questionCount Int       @default(0) @map("question_count")
  1748→  confidence    Float     @default(0) // Aggregate confidence
  1749→
  1750→  // Graph relationships
  1751→  questions     SkillQuestionSkill[]
  1752→  parentSkill   Skill?    @relation("SkillHierarchy", fields: [parentSkillId], references: [id])
  1753→  parentSkillId String?   @map("parent_skill_id")
  1754→  childSkills   Skill[]   @relation("SkillHierarchy")
  1755→
  1756→  // Timestamps
  1757→  createdAt    DateTime   @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  1758→  updatedAt    DateTime   @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  1759→
  1760→  @@unique([collectionId, slug])
  1761→  @@index([collectionId])
  1762→  @@index([questionCount])
  1763→  @@map("skills")
  1764→}
  1765→
  1766→/// SkillQuestionSkill - Junction table linking questions to skills
  1767→model SkillQuestionSkill {
  1768→  questionId String        @map("question_id")
  1769→  question   SkillQuestion @relation(fields: [questionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  1770→  skillId    String        @map("skill_id")
  1771→  skill      Skill         @relation(fields: [skillId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  1772→  relevance  Float         @default(1.0)
  1773→
  1774→  @@id([questionId, skillId])
  1775→  @@index([questionId])
  1776→  @@index([skillId])
  1777→  @@map("skill_question_skills")
  1778→}
  1779→
  1780→/// SkillQuestionTool - Junction table linking questions to tools mentioned
  1781→model SkillQuestionTool {
  1782→  questionId String        @map("question_id")
  1783→  question   SkillQuestion @relation(fields: [questionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  1784→  toolId     String        @map("tool_id")
  1785→  tool       Tool          @relation(fields: [toolId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  1786→  relevance  Float         @default(1.0)
  1787→
  1788→  @@id([questionId, toolId])
  1789→  @@index([questionId])
  1790→  @@index([toolId])
  1791→  @@map("skill_question_tools")
  1792→}
  1793→
  1794→/// SkillSession - Optional multi-turn conversation sessions
  1795→model SkillSession {
  1796→  id           String     @id @default(cuid())
  1797→
  1798→  // Collection relationship
  1799→  collectionId String     @map("collection_id")
  1800→  collection   Collection @relation(fields: [collectionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  1801→
  1802→  // Session state
  1803→  context      Json       @default("[]") @db.JsonB // Message history
  1804→  agentHash    String?    @map("agent_hash") @db.VarChar(64)
  1805→  agentName    String?    @map("agent_name") @db.VarChar(100)
  1806→
  1807→  // Timestamps
  1808→  createdAt    DateTime   @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  1809→  updatedAt    DateTime   @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  1810→  expiresAt    DateTime   @map("expires_at") // Auto-expire sessions
  1811→
  1812→  @@index([collectionId])
  1813→  @@index([expiresAt])
  1814→  @@map("skill_sessions")
  1815→}
  1816→
  1817→// ============================================================================
  1818→// Memory Models (Persistent Semantic Memory for AI Tool Collections)
  1819→// ============================================================================
  1820→
  1821→/// Memory - user-owned persistent memories for AI agents
  1822→model Memory {
  1823→  id               String    @id @default(cuid())
  1824→
  1825→  // Owner relationship
  1826→  userId           String    @map("user_id")
  1827→  user             User      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  1828→
  1829→  // Content
  1830→  content          Json      @db.JsonB // Arbitrary JSON payload
  1831→  summary          String    @db.VarChar(500) // Auto-generated or user-provided preview
  1832→  namespace        String?   @db.VarChar(100) // Grouping like "project-x", "personal"
  1833→  tags             String[]  @default([]) @db.Text // Categorization tags
  1834→
  1835→  // Embedding for semantic search
  1836→  embedding        Json      @db.JsonB // 3072-dim float array (text-embedding-3-large)
  1837→
  1838→  // Provenance tracking
  1839→  source           String    @db.VarChar(100) // Which tool created it ("createMemoryTool", "dashboard")
  1840→  sourceAgent      String?   @map("source_agent") @db.VarChar(200) // Agent name/identifier
  1841→  sourceContext    Json?     @map("source_context") @db.JsonB // Additional creation context
  1842→
  1843→  // Size tracking
  1844→  contentSizeBytes Int       @map("content_size_bytes")
  1845→
  1846→  // TTL support
  1847→  expiresAt        DateTime? @map("expires_at")
  1848→
  1849→  // Timestamps
  1850→  createdAt        DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  1851→  updatedAt        DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  1852→
  1853→  @@index([userId])
  1854→  @@index([userId, namespace])
  1855→  @@index([userId, createdAt])
  1856→  @@index([expiresAt])
  1857→  @@map("memories")
  1858→}
  1859→
  1860→// ============================================================================
  1861→// Execution Event Tracking (Unified per-tool execution tracking)
  1862→// ============================================================================
  1863→
  1864→/// ExecutionEvent - unified tracking for tool calls, agent runs, collection use, and scenario runs
  1865→model ExecutionEvent {
  1866→  id        String @id @default(cuid())
  1867→
  1868→  // Event classification
  1869→  eventType String @map("event_type") @db.VarChar(30) // 'tool_call' | 'agent_run' | 'collection_use' | 'scenario_run'
  1870→  source    String @db.VarChar(30) // 'mcp_http' | 'mcp_sse' | 'agent_chat' | 'ui_simulation' | 'scenario' | 'omega'
  1871→
  1872→  // Actor (no FK constraints - tracking must never fail due to entity deletion)
  1873→  userId   String? @map("user_id")
  1874→  apiKeyId String? @map("api_key_id")
  1875→
  1876→  // Entity references (no FK constraints for resilience)
  1877→  toolId       String? @map("tool_id")
  1878→  agentId      String? @map("agent_id")
  1879→  collectionId String? @map("collection_id")
  1880→
  1881→  // Denormalized for fast queries without joins
  1882→  toolName    String? @map("tool_name") @db.VarChar(200)
  1883→  packageName String? @map("package_name") @db.VarChar(214)
  1884→
  1885→  // Outcome
  1886→  status     String  @db.VarChar(20) // 'success' | 'error' | 'timeout'
  1887→  durationMs Int?    @map("duration_ms")
  1888→
  1889→  // Token usage (for agent runs)
  1890→  tokensIn  Int? @map("tokens_in")
  1891→  tokensOut Int? @map("tokens_out")
  1892→
  1893→  // Error details
  1894→  errorCode    String? @map("error_code") @db.VarChar(50)
  1895→  errorMessage String? @map("error_message") @db.Text
  1896→
  1897→  // Timestamps
  1898→  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  1899→
  1900→  @@index([userId, createdAt])
  1901→  @@index([collectionId, createdAt])
  1902→  @@index([toolId, createdAt])
  1903→  @@index([eventType, createdAt])
  1904→  @@index([createdAt])
  1905→  @@map("execution_events")
  1906→}
  1907→

content.content:
// This is your Prisma schema file,
// learn more about it in the docs: https://pris.ly/d/prisma-schema

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider  = "postgresql"
  url       = env("DATABASE_URL")
  directUrl = env("DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED") // Direct connection for migrations (bypasses pooler)
}

/// Package table - stores NPM package metadata (package-level)
model Package {
  id String @id @default(cuid())

  // NPM Metadata
  npmPackageName String   @unique @map("npm_package_name") @db.VarChar(214)
  npmVersion     String   @map("npm_version") @db.VarChar(50)
  npmPublishedAt DateTime @map("npm_published_at")
  npmDescription String?  @map("npm_description") @db.Text
  npmRepository  Json?    @map("npm_repository") @db.JsonB
  npmHomepage    String?  @map("npm_homepage") @db.Text
  npmLicense     String?  @map("npm_license") @db.VarChar(50)
  npmKeywords    String[] @default([]) @map("npm_keywords") @db.Text
  npmReadme      String?  @map("npm_readme") @db.Text
  npmAuthor      Json?    @map("npm_author") @db.JsonB
  npmMaintainers Json?    @map("npm_maintainers") @db.JsonB

  // TPMJS Package-Level Metadata
  category       String   @db.VarChar(50)
  env            Json?    @db.JsonB // Environment variables (shared across tools)
  frameworks     String[] @default([]) @db.Text
  tier           String   @db.VarChar(20) // 'minimal' | 'rich'
  discoveryMethod String  @map("discovery_method") @db.VarChar(20) // 'keyword' | 'changes-feed'
  isOfficial     Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_official")

  // Package Metrics
  npmDownloadsLastMonth Int? @default(0) @map("npm_downloads_last_month")
  githubStars           Int? @default(0) @map("github_stars")

  // Timestamps
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // Relations
  tools Tool[]

  @@index([category])
  @@index([isOfficial])
  @@index([npmDownloadsLastMonth])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@map("packages")
}

/// Tool table - stores individual tools within packages
model Tool {
  id String @id @default(cuid())

  // Package Relation
  packageId String  @map("package_id")
  package   Package @relation(fields: [packageId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  // Tool Identity
  name String @db.VarChar(100) // e.g., "helloWorldTool", "default"

  // Tool Metadata
  description String @db.Text
  parameters  Json?  @db.JsonB // Legacy/fallback - author-provided parameters array
  returns     Json?  @db.JsonB // @deprecated - will be auto-extracted in future
  aiAgent     Json?  @map("ai_agent") @db.JsonB // @deprecated - will be auto-extracted in future

  // Schema Extraction Fields
  inputSchema                Json?     @map("input_schema") @db.JsonB // Full JSON Schema from executor
  schemaSource               String?   @map("schema_source") @db.VarChar(20) // 'extracted' | 'author' | null
  schemaExtractedAt          DateTime? @map("schema_extracted_at") // Only updated on successful extraction
  schemaExtractionAttemptAt  DateTime? @map("schema_extraction_attempt_at") // Updated on every attempt (for rate limiting)
  schemaExtractionError      String?   @map("schema_extraction_error") @db.Text // Error message from last failed attempt

  // Tool Discovery Fields
  toolDiscoverySource String? @map("tool_discovery_source") @db.VarChar(20) // 'auto' | 'manual' | null

  // Tool Metrics
  qualityScore Decimal? @map("quality_score") @db.Decimal(3, 2) // 0.00 to 1.00
  likeCount    Int      @default(0) @map("like_count")

  // Health Status Fields
  importHealth     HealthStatus? @default(UNKNOWN) @map("import_health")
  executionHealth  HealthStatus? @default(UNKNOWN) @map("execution_health")
  lastHealthCheck  DateTime?     @map("last_health_check")
  healthCheckError String?       @map("health_check_error") @db.Text

  // Timestamps
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  // View tracking (denormalized, rolled up daily)
  viewCount      Int      @default(0) @map("view_count")

  // Execution tracking (denormalized, rolled up daily)
  executionCount Int      @default(0) @map("execution_count")

  // Rating aggregates
  averageRating Decimal? @map("average_rating") @db.Decimal(2, 1) // 1.0 to 5.0
  ratingCount   Int      @default(0) @map("rating_count")
  reviewCount   Int      @default(0) @map("review_count")

  // Relations
  simulations     Simulation[]
  healthChecks    HealthCheck[]
  collections     CollectionTool[]
  agents          AgentTool[]
  likes           ToolLike[]
  ratings         ToolRating[]
  reviews         ToolReview[]
  skillsCache     ToolSkillsCache?
  skillQuestions  SkillQuestionTool[]

  @@unique([packageId, name])
  @@index([qualityScore])
  @@index([likeCount])
  @@index([averageRating])
  @@index([ratingCount])
  @@index([viewCount])
  @@index([executionCount])
  @@index([reviewCount])
  @@index([importHealth])
  @@index([executionHealth])
  @@index([lastHealthCheck])
  @@map("tools")
}

/// Sync checkpoints - tracks progress of sync workers
model SyncCheckpoint {
  id String @id @default(cuid())

  source     String   @unique @db.VarChar(50) // 'changes-feed' | 'keyword-search' | 'metrics'
  checkpoint Json     @db.JsonB // Stores last sequence, timestamp, etc.
  updatedAt  DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  @@map("sync_checkpoints")
}

/// Sync logs - audit trail of sync operations
model SyncLog {
  id String @id @default(cuid())

  source    String   @db.VarChar(50) // 'changes-feed' | 'keyword-search' | 'metrics'
  status    String   @db.VarChar(20) // 'success' | 'error' | 'partial'
  processed Int      @default(0) // Number of packages processed
  skipped   Int      @default(0) // Number of packages skipped
  errors    Int      @default(0) // Number of errors encountered
  message   String?  @db.Text // Error message or summary
  metadata  Json?    @db.JsonB // Additional context
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")

  @@index([source])
  @@index([status])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@map("sync_logs")
}

/// Simulations - tracks tool playground executions
model Simulation {
  id String @id @default(cuid())

  // Relations
  toolId String @map("tool_id")
  tool   Tool   @relation(fields: [toolId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  // Request data
  userPrompt String  @map("user_prompt") @db.Text
  parameters Json?   @db.JsonB
  ipAddress  String? @map("ip_address") @db.VarChar(45)
  userAgent  String? @map("user_agent") @db.Text

  // Results
  status          String  @db.VarChar(20) // pending|running|success|error|timeout
  executionTimeMs Int?    @map("execution_time_ms")
  output          Json?   @db.JsonB
  error           String? @db.Text

  // AI metadata
  agentSteps Int     @default(0) @map("agent_steps")
  model      String? @db.VarChar(50)

  // Relations
  tokenUsage   TokenUsage?
  logs         ExecutionLog[]

  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  completedAt DateTime? @map("completed_at")

  @@index([toolId])
  @@index([status])
  @@index([ipAddress, createdAt]) // For rate limiting
  @@map("simulations")
}

/// Token usage - tracks token consumption per simulation
model TokenUsage {
  id String @id @default(cuid())

  simulationId String     @unique @map("simulation_id")
  simulation   Simulation @relation(fields: [simulationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  inputTokens    Int      @default(0) @map("input_tokens")
  toolDescTokens Int      @default(0) @map("tool_desc_tokens")
  schemaTokens   Int      @default(0) @map("schema_tokens")
  outputTokens   Int      @default(0) @map("output_tokens")
  totalTokens    Int      @default(0) @map("total_tokens")
  estimatedCost  Decimal? @map("estimated_cost") @db.Decimal(10, 6)

  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  @@map("token_usage")
}

/// Execution logs - detailed logs for each simulation
model ExecutionLog {
  id String @id @default(cuid())

  simulationId String     @map("simulation_id")
  simulation   Simulation @relation(fields: [simulationId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  timestamp DateTime @default(now())
  level     String   @db.VarChar(20) // info|warning|error|debug
  event     String   @db.VarChar(50)
  message   String   @db.Text
  metadata  Json?    @db.JsonB

  @@index([simulationId])
  @@map("execution_logs")
}

/// HealthCheck table - tracks full audit history of health checks
model HealthCheck {
  id String @id @default(cuid())

  // Relations
  toolId String @map("tool_id")
  tool   Tool   @relation(fields: [toolId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  // Check metadata
  checkType     HealthCheckType @map("check_type")
  triggerSource String          @map("trigger_source") @db.VarChar(50) // 'sync' | 'manual' | 'daily-cron'

  // Import check results
  importStatus HealthStatus @map("import_status")
  importError  String?      @map("import_error") @db.Text
  importTimeMs Int?         @map("import_time_ms")

  // Execution check results
  executionStatus HealthStatus @map("execution_status")
  executionError  String?      @map("execution_error") @db.Text
  executionTimeMs Int?         @map("execution_time_ms")
  testParameters  Json?        @map("test_parameters") @db.JsonB

  // Overall status
  overallStatus HealthStatus @map("overall_status")

  // Timestamps
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")

  @@index([toolId])
  @@index([checkType])
  @@index([overallStatus])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@map("health_checks")
}

/// Health status enum - tracks health check results
enum HealthStatus {
  UNKNOWN // Not yet checked
  HEALTHY // Passed health check
  BROKEN  // Failed health check
}

/// Health check type enum - types of health checks performed
enum HealthCheckType {
  IMPORT    // Only import check
  EXECUTION // Only execution check
  FULL      // Both import and execution
}

/// StatsSnapshot - daily snapshot of registry statistics for historical tracking
model StatsSnapshot {
  id String @id @default(cuid())

  // Snapshot date (one per day)
  date DateTime @unique @db.Date

  // Registry Overview
  totalTools      Int @default(0) @map("total_tools")
  totalPackages   Int @default(0) @map("total_packages")
  officialTools   Int @default(0) @map("official_tools")
  officialPackages Int @default(0) @map("official_packages")
  toolsWithSchema Int @default(0) @map("tools_with_schema")

  // Downloads & Stars
  totalNpmDownloads Int @default(0) @map("total_npm_downloads")
  totalGithubStars  Int @default(0) @map("total_github_stars")

  // Health Status Counts
  importHealthy   Int @default(0) @map("import_healthy")
  importBroken    Int @default(0) @map("import_broken")
  importUnknown   Int @default(0) @map("import_unknown")
  executionHealthy Int @default(0) @map("execution_healthy")
  executionBroken  Int @default(0) @map("execution_broken")
  executionUnknown Int @default(0) @map("execution_unknown")

  // Quality Distribution (stored as JSON for flexibility)
  qualityDistribution Json? @map("quality_distribution") @db.JsonB

  // Package Tiers
  tiersMinimal Int @default(0) @map("tiers_minimal")
  tiersRich    Int @default(0) @map("tiers_rich")

  // Execution Stats (daily)
  executionsTotal      Int @default(0) @map("executions_total")
  executionsSuccessful Int @default(0) @map("executions_successful")
  executionsFailed     Int @default(0) @map("executions_failed")
  executionsAvgTimeMs  Int? @map("executions_avg_time_ms")

  // Token Usage (daily)
  tokensInput    BigInt @default(0) @map("tokens_input")
  tokensOutput   BigInt @default(0) @map("tokens_output")
  tokensTotal    BigInt @default(0) @map("tokens_total")
  tokensCostUsd  Decimal? @map("tokens_cost_usd") @db.Decimal(10, 4)

  // Health Checks (daily)
  healthChecksRun Int @default(0) @map("health_checks_run")

  // Category Breakdown (stored as JSON)
  categories Json? @db.JsonB

  // Social Proof Fields (added for homepage real data)
  activeDevs7d     Int @default(0) @map("active_devs_7d")
  totalCollections Int @default(0) @map("total_collections")
  totalAgents      Int @default(0) @map("total_agents")
  totalSimulations Int @default(0) @map("total_simulations")

  // Execution Event Tracking (daily counts from ExecutionEvent table)
  eventToolCalls  Int @default(0) @map("event_tool_calls")
  eventAgentRuns  Int @default(0) @map("event_agent_runs")

  // Timestamps
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")

  @@index([date])
  @@map("stats_snapshots")
}

/// PageView - daily-bucketed view counts for entities (tools, collections, agents)
model PageView {
  id         String   @id @default(cuid())
  entityType String   @map("entity_type") @db.VarChar(20) // 'tool' | 'collection' | 'agent'
  entityId   String   @map("entity_id")
  viewCount  Int      @default(0) @map("view_count")
  date       DateTime @db.Date

  @@unique([entityType, entityId, date])
  @@index([entityType, entityId])
  @@index([date])
  @@map("page_views")
}

// ============================================================================
// Better Auth Models
// ============================================================================

/// User table - stores authenticated users
model User {
  id            String    @id @default(cuid())
  name          String
  email         String    @unique
  emailVerified Boolean   @default(false) @map("email_verified")
  image         String?
  username      String?   @unique @db.VarChar(30) // URL-friendly username (nullable for migration)

  // Tier for rate limiting and feature access
  tier          UserTier  @default(FREE)

  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  sessions         Session[]
  accounts         Account[]
  collections      Collection[]
  agents           Agent[]
  apiKeys          UserApiKey[]
  toolLikes        ToolLike[]
  toolRatings      ToolRating[]
  toolReviews      ToolReview[]
  collectionLikes  CollectionLike[]
  agentLikes       AgentLike[]
  activities       UserActivity[]
  bridgeConnection BridgeConnection?
  tpmjsApiKeys     TpmjsApiKey[]     @relation("UserTpmjsApiKeys")
  usageSummaries   ApiUsageSummary[] @relation("UserUsageSummaries")
  memories         Memory[]

  @@index([username])
  @@map("users")
}

/// Session table - stores user sessions
model Session {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String   @map("user_id")
  token     String   @unique
  expiresAt DateTime @map("expires_at")
  ipAddress String?  @map("ip_address")
  userAgent String?  @map("user_agent")

  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId])
  @@map("sessions")
}

/// Account table - stores auth provider accounts (including email/password)
model Account {
  id           String    @id @default(cuid())
  userId       String    @map("user_id")
  accountId    String    @map("account_id")
  providerId   String    @map("provider_id")
  accessToken  String?   @map("access_token") @db.Text
  refreshToken String?   @map("refresh_token") @db.Text
  idToken      String?   @map("id_token") @db.Text
  expiresAt    DateTime? @map("expires_at")
  password     String?

  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId])
  @@map("accounts")
}

/// Verification table - stores email verification tokens
model Verification {
  id         String   @id @default(cuid())
  identifier String
  value      String
  expiresAt  DateTime @map("expires_at")

  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")

  @@map("verifications")
}

// ============================================================================
// Collection Models
// ============================================================================

/// Collection - user-created groups of tools
model Collection {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())

  // Owner relationship
  userId      String   @map("user_id")
  user        User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  // Collection metadata
  name        String   @db.VarChar(100)
  slug        String?  @db.VarChar(50) // URL-friendly identifier (nullable for migration)
  description String?  @db.VarChar(500)
  isPublic    Boolean  @default(false) @map("is_public")
  likeCount   Int      @default(0) @map("like_count")

  // View tracking (denormalized, rolled up daily)
  viewCount      Int      @default(0) @map("view_count")

  // Execution tracking (denormalized, rolled up daily)
  executionCount Int      @default(0) @map("execution_count")

  // Executor configuration (optional - uses system default if not set)
  executorType   String? @map("executor_type") @db.VarChar(50)
  executorConfig Json?   @map("executor_config") @db.JsonB

  // Tool environment variables (encrypted JSON: { "KEY": "value" })
  // These are passed to tools when executed
  envVars        Json?   @map("env_vars") @db.JsonB

  // Fork tracking - for "fork to use" model
  forkedFromId String?     @map("forked_from_id")
  forkedFrom   Collection? @relation("CollectionForks", fields: [forkedFromId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  forks        Collection[] @relation("CollectionForks")
  forkCount    Int         @default(0) @map("fork_count")

  // AI-generated use cases
  useCases            Json?     @map("use_cases") @db.JsonB
  useCasesGeneratedAt DateTime? @map("use_cases_generated_at")

content.content:
name: "tpmjs-official-tools"
root: "."

# AI Configuration
ai:
  provider: "openai"
  model: "gpt-4o-mini"

# =============================================================================
# PHILOSOPHY - Core principles that guide all tool development
# =============================================================================
philosophy:
  - "Every tool MUST be a working, production-ready implementation - no stubs, no TODOs"
  - "Tools use AI SDK v6 tool() + jsonSchema() pattern exclusively"
  - "Each tool does ONE thing exceptionally well (single-shot, one call in, one result out)"
  - "Tools return structured, typed outputs that agents can reliably parse"
  - "Error handling is explicit - throw meaningful errors, never silently fail"
  - "All async operations use proper error boundaries"
  - "Dependencies are minimal and production-stable (no alpha/beta packages unless necessary)"
  - "Tools are deterministic where possible - same input yields same output"
  - "Network I/O is async but tools are single-shot (no streaming, no multi-step orchestration inside)"

# =============================================================================
# DOMAIN - Entities, signals, and measures that define the problem space
# =============================================================================
domain:
  entities:
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Core web entities
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    url:
      fields: [href, domain, protocol, path, query, fragment]
      description: "A fully qualified URL with parsed components"

    webpage:
      fields: [url, title, html, text, metadata]
      description: "A fetched webpage with extracted content"

    redirect_chain:
      fields: [steps, finalUrl, statusCodes]
      description: "Full redirect trace from origin to destination"

    meta_tags:
      fields: [title, description, canonical, ogTags, twitterTags]
      description: "Extracted metadata for previews and SEO"

    json_ld:
      fields: [type, data, context]
      description: "Structured data extracted from JSON-LD blocks"

    link_catalog:
      fields: [internal, external, anchors, resolved]
      description: "Categorized links from a page"

    html_table:
      fields: [headers, rows, caption]
      description: "Normalized table data from HTML"

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Research & content entities
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    text_content:
      fields: [raw, sentences, paragraphs, wordCount]
      description: "Processed text with structural analysis"

    claim:
      fields: [statement, confidence, needsCitation, category, suggestedEvidence]
      description: "A factual assertion that can be verified"
      categories: [factual, statistical, quote, attribution, prediction]

    timeline_event:
      fields: [date, description, confidence, source, dateType]
      description: "A dated event with provenance"
      dateTypes: [specific, partial, relative, range]

    page_brief:
      fields: [url, title, summary, keyPoints, claims]
      description: "A summarized view of a webpage"

    comparison_result:
      fields: [agreements, conflicts, uniqueToA, uniqueToB, similarity]
      description: "Side-by-side analysis of two sources"

    credibility_score:
      fields: [score, signals, warnings, recommendations, confidence]
      description: "Trust assessment of a source"

    claim_checklist:
      fields: [claims, citedCount, uncitedCount, byPriority]
      description: "Extracted claims with citation status"

    timeline:
      fields: [events, dateRange, gaps, eventCount]
      description: "Chronological event sequence"

    rss_feed:
      fields: [title, link, items, lastBuildDate]
      description: "Parsed RSS/Atom feed with normalized items"

    rss_item:
      fields: [title, link, pubDate, summary, guid]
      description: "Individual feed item"

    sitemap:
      fields: [urls, isSitemapIndex, lastmod]
      description: "Parsed sitemap with URLs for crawling"

    robots_policy:
      fields: [userAgent, allow, disallow, crawlDelay, sitemaps]
      description: "Parsed robots.txt rules"

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Document & deliverable entities
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    executive_brief:
      fields: [whatHappened, soWhat, recommendation, audience]
      description: "Structured exec summary"

    runbook:
      fields: [prechecks, steps, rollback, verify, owners]
      description: "Operational procedure document"

    postmortem:
      fields: [timeline, impact, rootCause, hypotheses, actions, lessons]
      description: "Incident analysis document"

    faq:
      fields: [items, categories]
      description: "Question and answer pairs"

    glossary:
      fields: [terms, domain]
      description: "Domain terms with definitions"

    toc:
      fields: [entries, maxDepth]
      description: "Table of contents from headings"

    meeting_minutes:
      fields: [attendees, decisions, actionItems, notes]
      description: "Structured meeting record"

    adr:
      fields: [title, context, decision, alternatives, consequences, status]
      description: "Architecture Decision Record"

    changelog_entry:
      fields: [version, date, added, changed, fixed, removed]
      description: "Grouped change notes"

    release_notes:
      fields: [version, highlights, breaking, upgrades, audience]
      description: "User-facing release documentation"

    prd:
      fields: [problem, goals, nonGoals, ux, metrics, risks, rollout]
      description: "Product Requirements Document outline"

    acceptance_criteria:
      fields: [given, when, then, notes]
      description: "Testable requirement specification"

    test_plan:
      fields: [scenarios, steps, expected, priority, coverage]
      description: "QA test matrix"

    blog_post:
      fields: [frontmatter, content, formattedOutput]
      description: "A complete blog post with metadata"

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Data & transform entities
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    csv_data:
      fields: [headers, rows, delimiter]
      description: "Parsed CSV with type inference"

    yaml_data:
      fields: [data, comments]
      description: "Parsed YAML as JSON"

    json_data:
      fields: [data, repaired]
      description: "Parsed or repaired JSON"

    row_set:
      fields: [rows, schema, count]
      description: "Tabular data for operations"

    validation_result:
      fields: [valid, errors, warnings]
      description: "Schema validation outcome"

    text_chunks:
      fields: [chunks, totalLength, overlap]
      description: "Text split for processing"

    pivot_result:
      fields: [rows, index, columns, values]
      description: "Pivoted data transformation"
